title: What remains unknown?
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: Cosmology has strong evidence for several large-scale features of the universe, yet the physical nature of dark matter and dark energy remains unresolved.

misconception: A learner may choose: Whether telescopes can detect light
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Which is still an open cosmological question?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Which is still an open cosmological question? The physical nature of dark matter and dark energy. Cosmology has strong evidence for several large-scale features of the universe, yet the physical nature of dark matter and dark energy remains unresolved.
